what: The placement instrument's probe points for the D1b street vignette, five per footed piece, with the level the plan expects under each one. Generated by the same run that writes vignette-pieces.json, never hand-edited. An emitter raycasts its own geometry at x_m,z_m and compares what it hits to foot_y_m; it never re-derives Foot5 or the crossfall, because an instrument that computes its own datum is measuring itself.
